migrations.summary_en: agent-pack: sync and reconcile gain --only mcp|skills|plugins, so MCP entries can be synced without touching user-level Skills (and the reverse); --replace can be limited per type with --replace-mcp and --replace-skills; the preview counts conflicts per type and warns about user-level content that affects every project. The MCP tools agent_pack_sync and agent_pack_reconcile gain only, replaceMcp and replaceSkills. Behaviour without these options is unchanged.; agent-pack: system variables such as ${HOME} in MCP entries are no longer treated as credential keys and are expanded to this machine's paths at sync; with several mcp_sources, ${PLUGIN_ROOT} resolves per source, and sync and doctor block with the entry and path when the referenced file is missing.; Add inbox adopt: adopting a candidate and writing it to OPINION.md now takes one preview and one confirmation; decide --to formal now says it is not written yet.; agent-pack: reconcile --retire-plugin now also cleans every client entry of the retired plugin: Claude user-level Skill links pointing into it, and the Codex personal marketplace entry and plugin copy (archived to recovery first; the preview lists each step). Entries that are not cleaned automatically for safety (Claude MCP entries and install record, other Codex cache versions, config.toml) are listed under residuals with a manual step.; agent-pack: a non-portable MCP entry now fails sync and doctor with a one-line error and exit code 2 on all three clients, and the Codex and Cursor sync preview runs the same checks as --apply.; Recreating a deleted AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md of an adopted project with --accept now restores its registered managed regions; update --only content hints at the missing file.; After switching the project file language, check compares the Profile's language with the language the content lock recorded at the last render and, when they differ, points to fix update-content or init_project.py --mode refresh for a preview of the full replacement (advisory only: no files are rewritten, exit code and fingerprint are unchanged); update --only content adds the same hint after "nothing to update"; correct MIGRATION.md and INSTALL.md (#79).; update wording and backup location: a client chosen with --client is no longer called an "other client"; a blocked preview no longer tells you to add --apply; update previews name where replaced files will be backed up and --apply prints the actual path (content step and Cursor); --recovery-dir now also applies to Cursor steps; the config write sub-commands (including project-language) accept --recovery-dir (#80).; nudge install-hooks run from a package runner's temporary cache (npx and similar): the hook commands now use an installed stable entry (Cursor's plugin directory, then the runtime install's current); when none exists the preview warns and --apply refuses to write (exit code 2); --remove and existing hook entries are unaffected; INSTALL.md and nudge.md explain this (#81).; agent-pack: paths containing words such as credential, secret or token (project or HOME directory) no longer make sync --client claude reject the launcher's --env-file path as a possible secret; token-shaped argument values are still blocked and never echoed.; agent-pack: launcher-wrapped MCP entries that reference ${PLUGIN_ROOT} (e.g. package Skill paths) or ${PLUGIN_DATA} now start correctly instead of failing with 'credential env file missing key: PLUGIN_ROOT'; the launcher derives the package root from its own location and receives PLUGIN_DATA from the client via --plugin-data.

changelog:
## 2026-11-10 — agenthelm 6.13.0

### agent-pack 1.13.0

- agent-pack：sync / reconcile 新增 --only mcp|skills|plugins，可只同步 MCP 而不碰用户级 Skill（反之亦然）；--replace 的范围可按类型拆分为 --replace-mcp 与 --replace-skills；预览按类型汇总冲突数量，并提示会影响所有项目的用户级内容。MCP 工具 agent_pack_sync / agent_pack_reconcile 同步增加 only、replaceMcp、replaceSkills。不带这些参数时行为不变。
- agent-pack：MCP 条目里的 ${HOME} 等系统变量不再被当作凭据键，同步时展开为本机路径；合并多个来源时 ${PLUGIN_ROOT} 按各自来源解析，引用的文件找不到时 sync 与 doctor 阻塞并指出条目与路径。
- 新增 inbox adopt：候选从「采纳」到写入 OPINION.md 合并成一次预览与一次确认；decide --to formal 明确提示尚未写入。
- agent-pack：reconcile --retire-plugin 退役插件时一并清理各客户端的入口：Claude 指向该插件的用户级 Skill 链接，Codex 个人市场条目与插件副本（先归档到 recovery 再移除，预览逐项列出）；出于安全不自动处理的项（Claude MCP 条目与安装记录、Codex 缓存其它版本与 config.toml）在输出的 residuals 中列出并给出手工步骤。
- agent-pack：不可移植的 MCP 条目在三个客户端的 sync 与 doctor 中一律一行报错、退出码 2；Codex 与 Cursor 的 sync 预览与 --apply 使用同一套校验。
- 接管项目的 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md 被删除后，--accept 重建时带回已登记的受管区块；update --only content 对缺失文件给出恢复提示。
- 切换项目文件语言后，check 比较 Profile 的 language 与内容锁记录的上次渲染语言，不一致时提示用 fix update-content 或 init_project.py --mode refresh 预览整份替换（仅提示，不改写文件，不影响退出码与指纹）；update --only content 在“没有需要更新的内容”后给出同一提示；修正 MIGRATION.md 与 INSTALL.md 的说明（#79）。
- update 输出措辞与备份位置：--client 选定的客户端不再被称为“其他客户端”；预览被阻塞时不再提示追加 --apply；update 的预览写明被替换文件的备份位置、apply 写出实际路径（内容步骤与 Cursor 都覆盖），--recovery-dir 对 Cursor 步骤同样生效；config 的写子命令（含 project-language）支持 --recovery-dir（#80）。
- nudge install-hooks 经 npx 等包运行器的临时缓存运行时：hook 命令改用已安装的稳定入口（Cursor 插件目录，其次 runtime install 的 current），找不到则预览警告、--apply 拒绝写入（退出码 2）；--remove 与既有 hook 条目不受影响；INSTALL.md 与 nudge.md 说明这一点（#81）。
- agent-pack：项目或 HOME 的路径里含 credential、secret、token 等字样时，sync --client claude 不再把启动器的 --env-file 路径误判为疑似密钥；令牌形的参数值仍然阻塞且不回显。
- agent-pack：被启动器包装的 MCP 条目引用 ${PLUGIN_ROOT}（包内 Skill 路径等）或 ${PLUGIN_DATA} 时能正常启动，不再报 credential env file missing key: PLUGIN_ROOT；启动器按自身位置推导包根，PLUGIN_DATA 由客户端展开后经 --plugin-data 传入。

### agents-init 6.9.1

- 接管项目的 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md 被删除后，--accept 重建时带回已登记的受管区块；update --only content 对缺失文件给出恢复提示。

### opinion-manager 0.6.0

- 新增 inbox adopt：候选从「采纳」到写入 OPINION.md 合并成一次预览与一次确认；decide --to formal 明确提示尚未写入。

### suite 6.13.0

- 切换项目文件语言后，check 比较 Profile 的 language 与内容锁记录的上次渲染语言，不一致时提示用 fix update-content 或 init_project.py --mode refresh 预览整份替换（仅提示，不改写文件，不影响退出码与指纹）；update --only content 在“没有需要更新的内容”后给出同一提示；修正 MIGRATION.md 与 INSTALL.md 的说明（#79）。
- nudge install-hooks 经 npx 等包运行器的临时缓存运行时：hook 命令改用已安装的稳定入口（Cursor 插件目录，其次 runtime install 的 current），找不到则预览警告、--apply 拒绝写入（退出码 2）；--remove 与既有 hook 条目不受影响；INSTALL.md 与 nudge.md 说明这一点（#81）。
